title: Bundle TUI app into the release dist so bwrk dashboard works from the machine install
description: Found 2026-07-05: the machine bundle ships only the CLI; spawnAppProcess now errors clearly (a174fea6) but the real fix is packaging the TUI into the dist artifact.
acceptanceCriteria: bwrk dashboard launches the TUI from a standalone install.sh/npm install (no source checkout); tools/build-cli-dist.mjs bundles or embeds apps/tui; release smoke covers it
